name: WPC Sortable Cart Items for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
WPC Sortable Cart Items gives your customers control over their cart organization. This WooCommerce extension adds a sorting dropdown to the cart page, allowing users to easily reorder items based on:

  • Name: A to Z or Z to A
  • Price: Low to High or High to Low
  • Default: Return to the original addition order

Additionally, it empowers users with drag-and-drop functionality, letting them manually arrange items in their preferred order. The custom order is saved and persists even if the page is reloaded.

Key Features

  • Sorting Dropdown: Easily sort cart items by Name or Price.
  • Drag & Drop: Manually reorder cart items with a simple drag-and-drop interface.
  • Persistent Order: The sorted order is saved to the session and remains after cart updates or page reloads.
  • Lightweight: Optimized for performance with minimal assets.

Need more features?

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wpc-sortable-cart-items directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to your Cart page to see the new sorting options in action.
